item.title: Anchor Bolts rev 2
item.content:encoded:
Anchor Bolts

BY CALIFORNIA FASTENER

California Fastener — your trusted source for premium-quality anchor bolts.

Whether you're building industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, or commercial projects, we provide durable, reliable anchor bolts in various materials, styles, and configurations to ensure your projects foundation is secure.

Anchors for every applicaiton.

headed anchors

anchor rods & assemblies

bent anchors

All Material Grades

We specialize in a comprehensive selection of anchor bolts made to meet rigorous industry standards. No matter your project requirements, we have the materials and configurations you need.

ASTM F1554

  • Low-carbon steel for general-purpose applications.

  • High-strength, low-alloy steel for medium-strength needs.

  • Heat-treated, high-strength bolts for critical structural applications.

ASTM A193

  • A193 Grade B7 anchor bolts are made from chromium-molybdenum alloy steel, offering high tensile strength and excellent performance in high-pressure and high-temperature conditions. These bolts are widely used in power plants, oil & gas, and heavy machinery installations.

  • Made from 304 stainless steel, provide excellent corrosion resistance and good mechanical properties across various temperatures. They are ideal for outdoor structures, food processing, and pharmaceutical industries.

  • Made from 316 stainless steel, offering superior resistance to saltwater, chemicals, and harsh environments. These bolts are the best choice for marine construction, chemical plants, and wastewater treatment facilities, where long-term durability is critical.

ASTM F593

  • 304 Stainless Steel is one of the most widely used stainless steel grades due to its excellent combination of strength, corrosion resistance, and affordability.

  • 316 Stainless Steel is an upgraded version of 304SS, offering even higher resistance to corrosion, chemicals, and extreme environments.

Full Anchor Bolt Assemblies

We understand that a secure anchoring system requires more than just bolts. That’s why we provide full anchor bolt assemblies, including:

  • Nuts & Washers – Available in standard or heavy-duty options.

  • Square Plate Washers – Essential for preventing the pull-out of cast in place anchors — also of used for distributing loads evenly across the surface.

  • Template Plates – Pre-drilled plates for precise alignment and installation of anchor bolts.

By offering these components as part of a complete assembly, we ensure your project is streamlined, efficient, and built to last.

Custom Anchor Bolt Solutions

Need anchor bolts for a unique application? We’ve got you covered. California Fastener specializes in fabricating custom anchor bolts tailored to your specific requirements. From custom threading and lengths to specialty materials and coatings, we deliver precision-engineered solutions to fit any project.

Applications of Anchor Bolts

Our anchor bolts are trusted across a wide range of industries and applications, including:

  • Construction – Securing structural steel columns, beams, and framing systems.

  • Industrial Machinery – Anchoring heavy equipment and machines.

  • Infrastructure Projects – Used in bridges, highways, tunnels, and other critical structures.

  • Renewable Energy – Securing wind turbines and solar panel foundations.

Dont forget your

Template Plates

Anchor bolt template plates ensure accurate bolt placement and easy installations. These plates help maintain proper spacing and alignment, preventing installation errors and reducing setup time. Made from high-strength steel, our template plates are built for durability and reliability in construction, industrial, and infrastructure projects.

We offer custom template plates in various sizes, thicknesses, and hole configurations to match specific anchor bolt layouts. Whether used for steel structures, bridges, or heavy machinery foundations, our plates provide a stable and efficient anchoring solution.

item.title: OLD - CNC Machining
item.content:encoded:
CNC Machining

Precision CNC Machining Services in California for Custom Fasteners

California Fastener provides precision custom CNC fasteners, custom machined fasteners, and expert custom machining services for customers with exacting requirements. Our CNC machining capabilities support prototypes through production runs, delivering tight tolerances, consistent quality, and fasteners manufactured to your specifications.

Why Choose California Fastener for CNC Machining?

  • Advanced CNC Technology – We utilize the latest CNC mills, lathes, and multi-axis machines to produce complex parts with tight tolerances

  • Custom & High-Volume Production – From prototypes to large-scale production, we handle orders of all sizes

  • Certified Quality – Our commitment to strict quality control ensures parts meet industry standards and exceed expectations

  • Fast Turnaround Times – We optimize production workflows to provide quick, on-time deliveries.

  • Competitive Pricing – Our cost-efficient machining processes deliver high-quality parts at affordable rates

CNC Turning

  • High-Speed Precision for Cylindrical Parts: CNC turning ensures exceptional accuracy and consistency in manufacturing shafts, bushings, and custom fasteners, delivering tight tolerances and flawless surface finishes

  • Cost-Effective for High-Volume Production: With automated tool changes and continuous operation, CNC turning maximizes efficiency and repeatability, making it an ideal choice for mass production without compromising quality

  • Advanced Multi-Axis Capabilities: Our modern CNC lathes offer multi-axis turning with live tooling, allowing for complex cuts, drilling, and contouring in a single setup, reducing production time and improving part accuracy

CNC Milling

  • Unmatched Precision & Complex Geometries: CNC milling allows for micron-level accuracy, enabling the production of intricate 3D shapes, contours, and fine details that traditional machining cannot achieve.

  • Multi-Axis Capability for Maximum Efficiency: Our advanced CNC machines can cut, drill, and shape materials from multiple angles in a single setup, reducing production time while increasing accuracy. They can also use 3-axis and 4-axis milling.

  • Scalability from Prototypes to High-Volume Production: Whether you need a one-off prototype or mass production, CNC milling ensures consistent quality, repeatability, and cost efficiency at any scale.

Mastering Precision Custom Machining

At California Fastener, we don’t just custom machine fasteners and components — we craft precision-engineered solutions that power industries forward.

Materials We Specialize In

We work with a wide range of materials, ensuring that each part meets the exact strength, weight, and corrosion resistance required for its application.

Alloy Steel

Alloy steels such as B7 and B16 are designed for high-strength, high-temperature applications. B7 steel offers superior tensile strength and heat resistance for bolts, studs, and pressure vessels, while B16 steel excels in high-temperature pipelines and superheated steam systems. Our CNC machining expertise guarantees precision and durability in every component.

Stainless Steel

Stainless steel delivers exceptional strength, corrosion resistance, and heat tolerance, making it essential for medical, aerospace, and industrial applications. 304 stainless steel is widely used for structural and food-grade components, while 316 stainless steel excels in marine and chemical environments. 17-4 PH stainless steel offers high hardness and wear resistance, ideal for high-stress applications.

Aluminum

Aluminum is ideal for aerospace, automotive, and industrial applications because it is lightweight, corrosion-resistant, and machinable. 6061 aluminum balances strength and cost-effectiveness, while 7075 aluminum offers superior tensile strength for high-stress environments. Our CNC machining ensures precision and flawless finishes for prototypes and large-scale production.

Brass & Copper

Brass and copper offer excellent conductivity, corrosion resistance, and superior machinability. Brass is ideal for valves, fittings, and precision instruments, while copper is used in heat exchangers and electrical components. Our CNC machining processes ensure high precision and impeccable surface finishes.

Titanium

Titanium combines incredible strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance, making it a top choice for aerospace, medical, and defense industries. Grade 2 titanium is ideal for marine and chemical applications, while Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) is used in jet engines, implants, and high-performance parts. Our CNC machining ensures precision without compromising durability.

Superalloys

Inconel and other superalloys withstand extreme temperatures, pressure, and corrosion, making them essential for aerospace, power generation, and chemical processing. Inconel 625 and 718 provide superior strength and oxidation resistance, making them ideal for jet engines, turbines, and high-performance industrial parts. Our specialized machining ensures precision and durability.

item.title: CNC Machining
item.content:encoded:
CNC Machining

Precision CNC Machining for Custom Fasteners & Components

Fast Quotes - Tight Tolerances - USA-Made

California Fastener provides precision custom CNC fasteners, custom machined fasteners, and expert custom machining services for customers with exacting requirements. Our CNC machining capabilities support prototypes through production runs, delivering tight tolerances, consistent quality, and fasteners manufactured to your specifications.

Why Engineers & Buyers Trust California Fastener:

  • Reliability: Trusted USA partner – Strict in-house quality control processes, consistent repeatability, full traceability from raw material to finished part

  • Speed: 24 hour quotes • 3–5 day prototypes • Rapid production turnaround

  • Precision: Ultra-tight tolerances (±0.0005") • GD&T support • Built to print/drawings with micron-level accuracy

  • Expertise: Custom fasteners specialists + precision components • Multi-axis CNC turning/milling

CNC Turning

  • High-Speed Precision for Cylindrical Parts: CNC turning ensures exceptional accuracy and consistency in manufacturing shafts, bushings, and custom fasteners, delivering tight tolerances and flawless surface finishes

  • Cost-Effective for High-Volume Production: With automated tool changes and continuous operation, CNC turning maximizes efficiency and repeatability, making it an ideal choice for mass production without compromising quality

  • Advanced Multi-Axis Capabilities: Our modern CNC lathes offer multi-axis turning with live tooling, allowing for complex cuts, drilling, and contouring in a single setup, reducing production time and improving part accuracy

CNC Milling

  • Unmatched Precision & Complex Geometries: CNC milling allows for micron-level accuracy, enabling the production of intricate 3D shapes, contours, and fine details that traditional machining cannot achieve.

  • Multi-Axis Capability for Maximum Efficiency: Our 5-axis advanced CNC machines can cut, drill, and shape materials from multiple angles in a single setup, reducing production time while increasing accuracy.

  • Scalability from Prototypes to High-Volume Production: Whether you need a one-off prototype or mass production, CNC milling ensures consistent quality, repeatability, and cost efficiency at any scale.

Laser Scanning

  • Advanced Scanning & CMM Inspection — Use fast 3D laser scanning for full surface capture and precise CMM for micron-level measurements—verifying tight tolerances (±0.0005"), GD&T features like true position and surface profile, dimensions, and blueprint specs with full accuracy and repeatability.

  • Complete Quality Check — Combines scanning and CMM for full traceability, defect detection, and documented proof—ensuring zero-defect custom components.

  • Reverse Engineering & Prototyping — Scan existing parts to create accurate CAD models fast—ideal for prototyping, duplicating legacy fasteners, or improving designs with precise data.

Precision CNC Machined Components

At California Fastener, we don’t just custom machine fasteners and components — we craft precision-engineered solutions that power industries forward. From prototype to production.

Materials We Specialize In

We work with a wide range of materials, ensuring that each part meets the exact strength, weight, and corrosion resistance required for its application. Domestic sourcing preferred – full material certifications and traceability.

Alloy Steel

Alloy steels such as B7 and B16 are designed for high-strength, high-temperature applications. B7 steel offers superior tensile strength and heat resistance for bolts, studs, and pressure vessels, while B16 steel excels in high-temperature pipelines and superheated steam systems. Our CNC machining expertise guarantees precision and durability in every component.

Stainless Steel

Stainless steel delivers exceptional strength, corrosion resistance, and heat tolerance, making it essential for medical, aerospace, and industrial applications. 304 stainless steel is widely used for structural and food-grade components, while 316 stainless steel excels in marine and chemical environments. 17-4 PH stainless steel offers high hardness and wear resistance, ideal for high-stress applications.

Aluminum

Aluminum is ideal for aerospace, automotive, and industrial applications because it is lightweight, corrosion-resistant, and machinable. 6061 aluminum balances strength and cost-effectiveness, while 7075 aluminum offers superior tensile strength for high-stress environments. Our CNC machining ensures precision and flawless finishes for prototypes and large-scale production.

Brass & Copper

Brass and copper offer excellent conductivity, corrosion resistance, and superior machinability. Brass is ideal for valves, fittings, and precision instruments, while copper is used in heat exchangers and electrical components. Our CNC machining processes ensure high precision and impeccable surface finishes.

Titanium

Titanium combines incredible strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance, making it a top choice for aerospace, medical, and defense industries. Grade 2 titanium is ideal for marine and chemical applications, while Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) is used in jet engines, implants, and high-performance parts. Our CNC machining ensures precision without compromising durability.

Superalloys

Inconel and other superalloys withstand extreme temperatures, pressure, and corrosion, making them essential for aerospace, power generation, and chemical processing. Inconel 625 and 718 provide superior strength and oxidation resistance, making them ideal for jet engines, turbines, and high-performance industrial parts. Our specialized machining ensures precision and durability.

Every quote gets personal attention from our team. Upload files and specs for expert review, tight-tolerance recommendations, and a response within 24 hours.

post-install anchors

Suitable for retrofitting applications, post-install anchors are effective for use in hardened concrete or modern construction demands

All Material Grades

California Fastener specializes in a comprehensive selection of anchor bolts designed to meet rigorous industry standards. With various material grades and configurations, we offer solutions tailored to your specific project requirements.

ASTM F1554

  • Low-carbon steel for general-purpose applications.

  • High-strength, low-alloy steel for medium-strength needs.

  • Heat-treated, high-strength bolts for critical structural applications.

ASTM A193

  • A193 Grade B7 anchor bolts are made from chromium-molybdenum alloy steel, offering high tensile strength and excellent performance in high-pressure and high-temperature conditions. These bolts are widely used in power plants, oil & gas, and heavy machinery installations.

  • Made from 304 stainless steel, provide excellent corrosion resistance and good mechanical properties across various temperatures. They are ideal for outdoor structures, food processing, and pharmaceutical industries.

  • Made from 316 stainless steel, offering superior resistance to saltwater, chemicals, and harsh environments. These bolts are the best choice for marine construction, chemical plants, and wastewater treatment facilities, where long-term durability is critical.

ASTM F593

  • 304 Stainless Steel is one of the most widely used stainless steel grades due to its excellent combination of strength, corrosion resistance, and affordability.

item.content:encoded:
About Us

Welcome to California Fastener, your one-stop destination for high-quality fasteners and industrial supplies. We are a family-owned and operated business located in the Bay Area, serving the needs of a diverse range of industries for over a decade.

Our mission is to provide our customers with the best products, exceptional customer service, and competitive prices. We strive to maintain long-term relationships with our clients by understanding their unique needs and offering tailored solutions that meet or exceed their expectations.

At CaliforniaFastener.com, we take pride in our vast selection of products, including screws, bolts, nuts, washers, anchors, and other hardware supplies. We work with leading manufacturers to ensure that our inventory consists of the latest products in the market, designed to withstand the toughest conditions.

We understand the importance of timely delivery and efficient service, and that's why we offer same-day shipping for orders placed before 3 pm PST. Our knowledgeable and experienced staff is always available to answer any questions you may have about our products or services.

Thank you for choosing California Fastener and we look forward to serving you soon!

Industries we service

  • Oil & Gas

    Our fasteners are designed for durability and reliability with resistance to corrosion and high pressures, they ensure safety and efficiency in the world's most demanding environments.

  • Power Generation

    Our products are engineered and procured to meet the rigorous demands of various power generation modalities including fossil fuel, steam, nuclear, and renewable energy sources.

  • Power Transmission

    High-quality fasteners secure the infrastructure of these networks, from substations to transmission lines. Our products are built to resist environmental wear and tear, ensuring long-term reliability and performance in powering homes, businesses, and communities.

  • Construction

    We supply fasteners that are essential in building commercial and residential structures, offering reliability from the ground up. Our products are the preferred choice for construction projects aiming for longevity and aesthetic appeal.

  • Manufacturing

    We provide solutions tailored to meet the rigorous demands of the manufacturing industry. Our products ensure durability, precision alignment, and superior load distribution, crucial for optimizing machinery performance and extended lifecycle.

  • Transportation & Infrastructure

    Providing fastening solutions that support the construction and maintenance of roads, bridges, tunnels, and public transit systems. Our fasteners ensure these structures are safe, durable, and ready to withstand the rigors of daily use.
